links.outcome: Sensitivity and specificity of a guardrail detecting psychiatric crises in text messages
links.effect: On the Verily dataset, sensitivity 0.990, specificity 0.992, F1 0.939, category-level sensitivity 0.917-0.992, specificity ≥0.978. On the NVIDIA subset, sensitivity 0.982, accuracy 0.921, specificity 0.859.
links.quote: The VMHG demonstrated high sensitivity (0.990) and specificity (0.992) on the Verily dataset, with an F1-score of 0.939 and high category-level sensitivity (0.917-0.992) and specificity (≥0.978).

links.outcome: Missed and false-positive crisis detection versus comparator guardrails
links.effect: VMHG had significantly higher sensitivity than NVIDIA and OpenAI guardrails (all p < 0.001), with comparable specificity to OpenAI (p = 0.094) and lower than NVIDIA (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Compared with NVIDIA and OpenAI guardrails, the VMHG achieved significantly higher sensitivity (all p < 0.001) and comparable specificity (NVIDIA p < 0.001, OpenAI p = 0.094).

screen.reason: Evaluates a specialized mental health safety guardrail system designed to identify psychiatric crises in text-based conversations against existing standard moderation/guardrail tools.
